paper_metadata.title: LongCat-Flash-Thinking-2601 Technical Report
paper_metadata.abstract: We introduce LongCat-Flash-Thinking-2601, a 560-billion-parameter open-source Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) reasoning model with superior agentic reasoning capability. LongCat-Flash-Thinking-2601 achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source models on a wide range of agentic benchmarks, including agentic search, agentic tool use, and tool-integrated reasoning. Beyond benchmark performance, the model demonstrates strong generalization to complex tool interactions and robust behavior under noisy real-world environments. Its advanced capability stems from a unified training framework that combines domain-parallel expert training with subsequent fusion, together with an end-to-end co-design of data construction, environments, algorithms, and infrastructure spanning from pre-training to post-training. In particular, the model's strong generalization capability in complex tool-use are driven by our in-depth exploration of environment scaling and principled task construction. To optimize long-tailed, skewed generation and multi-turn agentic interactions, and to enable stable training across over 10,000 environments spanning more than 20 domains, we systematically extend our asynchronous reinforcement learning framework, DORA, for stable and efficient large-scale multi-environment training. Furthermore, recognizing that real-world tasks are inherently noisy, we conduct a systematic analysis and decomposition of real-world noise patterns, and design targeted training procedures to explicitly incorporate such imperfections into the training process, resulting in improved robustness for real-world applications. To further enhance performance on complex reasoning tasks, we introduce a Heavy Thinking mode that enables effective test-time scaling by jointly expanding reasoning depth and width through intensive parallel thinking.

extraction_data.innovation: Domain-parallel expert training with subsequent fusion: trains experts on separate domains then fuses them to optimize long-tailed, skewed generation and multi-turn agentic interactions; improves stability and generalization over single-model training. ; End-to-end co-design of data, environments, algorithms, and infrastructure: systematically extends asynchronous RL framework (DORA) for stable, efficient large-scale multi-environment training across >10,000 environments and 20 domains; enables scalable agentic reasoning beyond traditional single-environment setups. ; HeavyThinking mode: enables effective test-time scaling by jointly expanding reasoning depth and width through intensive parallel thinking; improves performance on complex reasoning tasks without extended sequential thinking. ; Real-world noise incorporation: systematically analyzes and decomposes real-world noise patterns, designing targeted training procedures to explicitly incorporate imperfections into the training process; improves robustness for real-world applications compared to idealized training settings.
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: LongCat-Flash-Chat data distribution; large-scale text corpora
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Multi-turn agentic tool-use and environment interactions, Agentic reasoning, tool-use, planning
extraction_data.extension: Heavy Thinking Mode decomposes challenging problem solving into complementary stages that jointly expand reasoning width and depth.
extraction_data.research_problem: Agentic reasoning, complex tool interactions, and robust behavior under noisy real-world environments
extraction_data.application: Agentic reasoning, agentic search, agentic tool use, tool-integrated reasoning, complex tool interactions
extraction_data.finetuning_data: Synthesized structured agentic trajectories, Hybrid data synthesis framework (text-driven and environment-grounded); structured agentic trajectories; planning-centric data.
extraction_data.hardware_description: ~400 physical machines with thousands of accelerators; up to 32,000 environments
extraction_data.attention_mechanism: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA), Zig-Zag Attention Design
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pre-training -> mid-training (synthesized agentic trajectories) -> post-training (asynchronous RL with DORA, HeavyThinking mode)
extraction_data.reasoning_mode: HeavyThinking mode (test-time scaling via parallel thinking)
extraction_data.moe_configuration: 560B total parameters, 27B activated parameters on average per token
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Synthesized structured agentic trajectories, Hybrid data synthesis pipeline: text-driven synthesis (filtering, tool extraction, synthesis & refinement from large-scale text corpora) and environment-grounded synthesis.
extraction_data.rl_algorithm: Asynchronous reinforcement learning (DORA framework), Reinforcement Learning (curriculum-based RL strategy)
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Reward assessment, Outcome-oriented supervision with relaxed penalties on long trajectories; on-policy self-verification rewards
extraction_data.benchmark_result: Mathematical Reasoning w/ Tools: 93.5/95.1/77.7/51.9/52.0; Agentic Search: 56.6/73.1, 69.0/77.7, 79.5; Agentic Tool-Use: 88.6, 76.5, 99.3, 88.2, 67.1, 29.3, 20.5, 35.8; GeneralQA: 25.2; HLE text-only: 80.5/85.2; Coding: 82.8, 42.2, 47.7, 70.0; BrowseComp: 73.1%; RWSearch: 77.7%; τ2-Bench: 88.2%; VitaBench: 29.3%
extraction_data.post_training_infrastructure: Dynamic Orchestration for Asynchronous Rollout (DORA), multi-version asynchronous training system

extraction_data.innovation: ZigZagAttention, a sparse attention mechanism combining MLA with Streaming Sparse Attention (SSA) that replaces ~50% of full-attention layers during mid-training, enabling efficient scaling to ultra-long contexts (up to 1M tokens) with ~1.5x inference speedup.
extraction_data.extension: ZigZagAttention (sparse attention mechanism combining MLA with Streaming Sparse Attention)
extraction_data.research_problem: Long-context language modeling and efficiency-performance trade-off
